title: Every answer reaches the copy planners and the page and menu judges, not only the description
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-shared.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/site-brief-normalize.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "beside a description, the other answers reach the copy as their own field; without one they are the description, said once"; "the other answers ride in the site block as their own field, so every planner reads them beside the description"; "a judge is shown everything the customer said up to its bound, not the first 300 characters"; "the planner reads the other answers beside the description, and the menu judge everything the customer said"; "the planners read the other answers beside the description, and the judge everything the customer said".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 152).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): beside a description the other answers (sector, an admin's question) ride in the site block as `details` (at most 1200 characters) that the WordPress and Joomla planners read, and the page and menu judges see everything the customer said up to JUDGE_BRIEF_MAX (1200), not the first 300 characters.
evidence: Ledger L06, 05/10/2026 (code reading, brief-normalize.js and the WordPress judge): with a description answered, the other answers never reached the models writing the copy, and the judges read only spokenOf(brief).slice(0, 300). Red 71cadfce9, fix 1f8348fe9.
fence: Without a description the other answers are the description, said once; what the planners may write is unchanged.

tests: beside a description, the other answers reach the copy as their own field; without one they are the description, said once
the other answers ride in the site block as their own field, so every planner reads them beside the description
a judge is shown everything the customer said up to its bound, not the first 300 characters
the planner reads the other answers beside the description, and the menu judge everything the customer said
the planners read the other answers beside the description, and the judge everything the customer said
